sources.title: TNPCB real-time water quality monitoring dashboard: monthly means of sensor readings
sources.license: LICENCE UNVERIFIED - see notes. Public Tamil Nadu government dashboard with no reuse terms stated; its own page switches the download buttons off. Monthly means published with attribution.

provenance.note: Erode district's rivers, groundwater and industry (scope erode-rivers; the district's own scope id is tn-erode). The district boundary is the frame and TN WRD's sub-basins, clipped to it, are the catchments (shedId). The industry register holds only units TNGIS matched to a land parcel, so every count is a lower bound; sector comes from the reviewed TNPCB type-code lookup pipeline-inputs/basins/erode-rivers/tnpcb-type-sectors.json.

series.label: BOD (monthly mean, sensor)
series.note: The latest month is a part-month.
series.criterionLabel: BOD of 3 mg/L or less (outdoor bathing criterion)
series.explainer: Each point is the month's mean of the station's sensor readings, as TNPCB's dashboard reports it. These are sensor readings, not laboratory results.
